summary: Lower a closed-shape ordinary object literal to a generated C# reference type only under strict escape/reflection restrictions.

semantics.fields: last duplicate definition semantics must already be normalized if duplicates allowed; this rule excludes observable duplicates

caveats: The special object-literal form __proto__: expr changes [[Prototype]] and is excluded; a computed ['__proto__'] key is a normal data property.
Fallback is required if Object.keys/values/entries, delete, in, descriptors, prototypes, Symbols, computed keys, or dynamic access can observe JavaScript object semantics.
Generated C# properties must not reorder or duplicate initializer evaluation.
